decision.recommendation: GO — pause here (Option A). Do not start D4.
decision.rationale: The D1 + D2 redo + D3 redo stack successfully closes the safe-next-step arc from PR #530. The merged stack gives a clean audit posture (D1), disciplined flag handling (D2 redo), and quantified shadow evidence (D3 redo). Starting D4 now — whether design or runtime — would invert the audit-only posture and require its own governance review. Pause and switch to a different roadmap arc.
